assumptions: Bar-based conservative fills; no tick sequence or guaranteed liquidity.
Short availability is a scenario, not historical lending evidence.
One-times-equity gross cap; short proceeds do not expand the exposure budget.
Corporate-action fractional shares are retained until exit; new orders use whole shares.
Borrow accrues on prior marked short notional over elapsed calendar time / 365.

pnl_interval.method: circular moving blocks of daily P&L

metrics.risk_basis: Daily marked equity / defined capital; calendar complete eligible sessions including no-trade days.

limitations: Provider corporate-action history can be incomplete; unsupported/incomplete records block ordinary execution.
No point-in-time universe or stock-lending history is inferred from prices.

verification: Research output; not a product verification receipt or promise of live profitability.
